title: Psycho
blurb: Hitchcock's original, two sequels that follow Norman after his release, a fourth film that ignores both, and a shot-for-shot remake.

groups.title: The original and its first two sequels
Psycho IV: The Beginning
groups.note: Follows the 1960 film and ignores II and III.

note: Psycho IV was made for television and ignores parts II and III, following on from the 1960 film instead. The 1998 remake copies the original almost shot for shot. The TV series Bates Motel is a separate reimagining.
